package repro

// State belongs to the caller.
type State struct { Count int }

// Unrelated setup that the reducer should remove.
type Metadata struct { Label string }

func unrelated(value int) int {
    if value > 0 {
        return value + 1
    }
    return 0
}

// Local declarations can still reach shared state.
func Mutate(shared *State) {
    scratch := []int{1, 2, 3}; _ = scratch
    local := new(State)
    holder := &local
    *holder = shared
    local.Count++
}

func anotherUnrelated() string {
    return "noise"
}
